bs-anthropic-report-illustration.blurb: Use this Skill to create article illustrations.
bs-anthropic-report-illustration.description: Turn articles and research reports into bold editorial illustrations with a vintage print feel. Express the main idea through colour-block collage, single objects and abstract geometric prints.
bs-anthropic-report-illustration.about: Make a varied illustration series for a report or article in three looks: colour-block collage with found imagery, single objects on a flat colour field, and abstract geometric prints. The first preview shows 24 examples together; the second and third show 12 each. Every original is square. Bright screen-print colours lead the series, with muted archival palettes mixed in for contrast.
youGet: Colour-block collage, single-object studies and abstract geometric prints in one consistent series
Large objects that keep their natural photographic colour and patina
Square originals ready to crop for articles, reports and social posts
